      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Build changes provide supporting CMake wiring and subtree build integration for multiprocess IPC rather than resolving build or platform issues."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not carry the Docs label and does not primarily focus on documentation changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are incidental to the IPC implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extensively touches src/ipc, Cap'n Proto interface definitions, libmultiprocess, and multiprocess node/wallet initialization.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Advances the multiprocess project by adding the `-ipcconnect` option to `bitcoin-wallet` and `-ipcbind` to `bitcoin-node`. This implements the connection mechanism between the wallet executable and the node process, moving toward running the wallet as a separate process."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No mempool label and does not touch mempool data structures or policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no mempool or transaction policy components."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No P2P label and no peer-to-peer networking code touched.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Local IPC socket connections are unrelated to P2P network protocol and peer relay."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch RPC framework or method handling; IPC wallet RPC forwarding is planned for future follow-up work.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No RPC server or client changes are introduced in this PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test modifications are confined to testing libmultiprocess and IPC connection functionality.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes follow directly from the IPC implementation rather than modifying testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies the execution model of the `bitcoin-wallet` tool by adding the `-ipcconnect` option.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Expands `bitcoin-wallet` from an offline-only tool to one capable of connecting to a running node over IPC. This addresses the limitation where the tool 'cannot interact with a running node to access chain state, sync balances, or run wallet RPCs'."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Utils/log/libs label and adds signal handling utilities in `src/util/btcsignals.h` alongside init helpers.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds utility signal abstractions and process initialization routines used to coordinate multiprocess connections."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Wallet label and implements wallet Cap'n Proto interfaces to communicate with the chain.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Lays the interface groundwork for `bitcoin-wallet` to connect to a node and execute future online commands like syncing and wallet RPC serving. Direct wallet features are deferred to follow-ups."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
